system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Obfuscate (Unseen Presence), Basic Obtenebration. Devised jointly by Malkavian and Lasombra anarchs, this Discipline layers Obtenebration's shadow-wrapping over Obfuscate's mental concealment. Provided a shadow is available, the user spends a Blood Trait to stand perfectly motionless and wrap it around herself, remaining unseen as long as she stays still and silent; any movement or sound instantly disrupts the veil. Unlike ordinary Obfuscate, the shadow prevents even superior Auspex users from seeing through the effect, regardless of their Auspex rating relative to the user's Obfuscate. It remains rare and little-known due to the scarcity of Lasombra among the anarchs.

Costs 3 Experience Traits to learn.
system.duration: Until movement or sound breaks the effect
